summary: Comprehensive expert-level comparison of Apple M3, M4, and M5 base chips covering: TSMC process node differences (N3B/N3E/N3P), CPU architecture (Super Cores), GPU Neural Accelerators, Neural Engine TOPS progression (18→38→~50+), memory bandwidth (100→120→153 GB/s), Geekbench 6 benchmarks, media engine capabilities, battery life, connectivity (Thunderbolt, Wi-Fi 7), and real user experiences from Reddit and Hacker News. Includes honest buy/don't-buy recommendations with anti-sycophancy assessment.
